name: Watanuki Sakuya
source:
"Just once, I'd like to find something I can truly believe in."
Watanuki Sakuya.

A cynical girl who prefers to keep her distance from others. When visiting the village with her 'best friend', she happens to get caught up in the Hanamukenogi ceremony. She happens to have been treated like a slave by her 'best friend' for a 'certain reason'. She never lies, nor does she put on any appearances for show.

Flower: White Dandelions 
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [Chinamiwata] — Interference with the past.
[Translated from [url=https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url]]
